thin_warning: Curved perforated bands are nominal 0.95mm normal thickness. Central frame is model-strengthened toward 0.95mm normal thickness by varying vertical thickness with the local surface normal; the steep footward limit and Boolean overlaps mean actual raw-STL ray measurements govern. This is not measured original construction thickness. Perforations, thin seams and foot tabs remain fragile; arches, flared edges and central frame need support planning. All sampled erosion/ray warnings retained without exemptions.
limitations: Finite chosen regions only: not a full-surface minimum-thickness, bridge-span, strength, slicer, support-removal or physical-print certificate. Individual hole pattern is approximate, not source-measured.
